podcast.title: 21st Century Tweetpop Descendant
podcast.body: Beabadoobee is cited as a 21st-century artist whose Bedroom Pop music is a direct descendant of Tweetpop. This contemporary style, characterized by dreaminess, introspection, sensitivity, and vulnerability, is facilitated by the widespread availability of inexpensive and powerful recording technology, allowing for high-quality music production in intimate settings. "We wouldn't have artists like Girl in Red or Beba Dooby or Arlo Parks, Rex Orange County, and Sockermummy if it wasn't for the various flavors of Tweet Pop."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Filipino British Singer
podcast.body: Beabadoobee is identified as a Filipino British singer who rose to prominence within the bedroom pop scene in the 2010s. "Biba Dubie, a Filipino British singer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
